category.description: Job purpose; does not select an execution runner.

execution_mode.description: Pilot requires an explicit reduced preflight and intended full run. Null means unrecorded.

work_unit_policy.default: one independently scheduled execution is one Job
work_unit_policy.internal_steps: profile.steps reports progress within one execution; connect scheduled Jobs with depends_on
work_unit_policy.consolidation: jobs.submit.consolidates preserves completed source execution; list(include_consolidated=true) exposes all sources

semantics: Classification does not change kind, params, task level, verification, or dispatch.
